text: Review rejected the claim that deepEqual is the preferred assertion for strings. Current dummy-row tests use Assert.equal for the scalar text result. Keep deep comparisons for nested structures when needed. The test comment explains why it marks all but one message in the loop and checks the final all-read format separately. Review also removed leftover logs and comments and asked for follow-up work to name its bug. The historical landing still had one deepEqual despite resolved discussion; the newer source is the evidence for the adopted assertion style.
title: Use scalar equality for string test results and explain separate branches
